name: fable
description: Fable is an agent-native AI workspace for real work.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @fable/protocol build && pnpm --filter @fable/connectors build && pnpm --filter @fable/broker build && pnpm --filter @fable/hosted-runner build && pnpm --filter @fable/knowledge build && pnpm --filter @fable/desktop build && pnpm --filter @fable/marketing build && pnpm --filter @fable/waitlist build
scripts.verify:build: pnpm --filter @fable/protocol check:spine-parity && pnpm --filter @fable/connectors build && pnpm --filter @fable/broker build && pnpm --filter @fable/knowledge build && pnpm --filter @fable/desktop build && pnpm --filter @fable/marketing typecheck && pnpm --filter @fable/marketing build && node apps/marketing/scripts/check-claims.mjs apps/marketing/dist && pnpm --filter @fable/waitlist build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @fable/protocol check:spine-parity && pnpm --filter @fable/connectors build && pnpm --filter @fable/broker typecheck && pnpm --filter @fable/hosted-runner typecheck && pnpm --filter @fable/knowledge build && pnpm --filter @fable/desktop typecheck && pnpm --filter @fable/marketing typecheck && pnpm --filter @fable/waitlist typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @fable/connectors test && pnpm --filter @fable/broker test && pnpm --filter @fable/hosted-runner test && pnpm --filter @fable/knowledge test && pnpm --filter @fable/desktop test && pnpm --filter @fable/waitlist test && pnpm --filter @fable/marketing test
scripts.lint: eslint apps packages scripts --max-warnings=0 && node scripts/quality/check-explicit-any.mjs
scripts.quality: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm dead-code && pnpm cycles
scripts.perf:runtime: pnpm --filter @fable/connectors exec vitest run src/performance-baseline.test.ts && pnpm --filter @fable/knowledge exec vitest run src/performance-baseline.test.ts && cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml perf_
scripts.check: pnpm quality && pnpm verify:build && pnpm test && pnpm perf:check && pnpm perf:test && pnpm perf:runtime && pnpm release:test && pnpm tauri:check && pnpm audit:all
